A [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] '''Superfreighter''' carrying a cargo of munitions and six [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|''Scarab''-class droid starfighters]] was part of a nine-ship [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] convoy after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] commenced in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The [[Trade Federation Superfreighter|freighter]] was at the far end of the convoy and docked with a [[Trade Federation Freighter]] when a band of resistance fighters [[Skirmish over Naboo|arrived]] and decided to attack the convoy. [[Vana Sage]] disabled the freighter at the behest of [[Reti]], who boarded the freighter to steal munitions. The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] then decided to reprogram the complement of Scarabs to assist the raiders. After finishing loading, Reti departed and the freighter became another casualty to the raiders.

==Behind the scenes==
The Trade Federation Superfreighter appears in the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']]. The player, in the guise of Sage, must attack one of the nine Superfreighters in the convoy and disable it. The strategy guide points suggest targeting one particular freighter; this article follows the guide and assumes the player targets that ship.
